body:
🔥 Strong Mobs Datapack — Feature Summary

This datapack makes Minecraft significantly harder by giving hostile mobs new abilities, auras, and mechanics, all implemented in vanilla using commands.

🧟 Zombies

Always spawn with:

Full iron armor

Iron sword

Equipment:

Does not drop on death

Applied once per zombie (no re-equipping loops)

💀 Skeletons

Skeleton bows are replaced with:

Custom enchanted bows

Power III

Flame I

Multishot III

Skeletons properly fire multishot arrows

Bows cannot be farmed (no drops)

🕷️ Spiders

When a player is within 0.5 blocks:

Player is pulled toward the spider

A particle indicator shows the grab range

Creates a “sticky web” feeling instead of raw knockback

🧊 Slimes

Any player within 3 blocks:

Is effectively rooted in place

Movement is almost completely disabled

Makes slimes extremely dangerous in tight spaces

🌊 Drowned

Any player within 3 blocks:

Takes drowning-type damage

0.5 hearts per second

Damage uses the drown damage source

Armor does not reduce the damage

✨ Experience Orbs

XP orbs act as healing auras

Players within 2 blocks:

Gain Regeneration

Encourages risky movement toward XP during combat

👁️ Endermen

Any player within 5 blocks:

Receives Nausea

Effect is hidden (no particles)

Creates strong disorientation and pressure

🏹 Phantoms

All phantoms are:

Scaled to 2× size

Phantoms have a special ability:

Every 10 seconds

If a player is within 10 blocks:

A large particle blast appears on the player

Player takes 3 damage (1.5 hearts)

Uses a real per-phantom cooldown (no spam)

🌬️ Breezes

Any entity within 6 blocks:

Takes 1 damage per second

Damage applies to:

Players

Mobs

Breezes themselves are immune

Creates a dangerous “wind aura”

🧙 Witches

Every 10 seconds:

Targets the nearest player

Places a cobweb at the player’s position

Cooldown is per-witch

Webs persist until broken

Makes witches excellent crowd-control enemies

👻 Vexes

Vexes effectively have extended attack range

Damage is applied to players slightly outside normal melee distance

Creates the feeling of longer reach without teleporting or mods

⚙️ Technical Notes

Fully vanilla datapack

No mods required

Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.x

Uses:

Scoreboards for cooldowns

Entity tags for stability

No deprecated NBT

Performance-safe unless extreme mob counts are used

💀 Overall Design Goal

This datapack turns normal mobs into high-pressure combat threats, forcing players to:

Respect spacing

Manage positioning

React to overlapping mob auras

Adapt instead of brute-forcing fights
